_comment: Frozen evaluation seeds (spec 8.4.3). Written and committed BEFORE any
seed here was generated, audited or looked at, and never regenerated
after seeing a result. Re-drawing this list once a number is known
would make the benchmark a selection of agreeable worlds, which is the
rigged benchmark 8.4 exists to prevent. If it is ever rewritten, every
eval number already recorded is void and PROGRESS.md must say so.
The list is rule-generated rather than hand-picked, so there is nothing
to cherry-pick: 10000 + 37k for k = 1..24. The rule is the whole
justification; no seed was chosen for what it produces.
Disjoint from the development seed 7777 (spec 8.4.3 asks for a disjoint
development set, and 7777 has been inspected at length, so it cannot be
part of a blind set). Disjoint from 900000+, which backend/tests/conftest
hands out to tests on the same shared server.
24 seeds x 7 suspects x up to 20 claims is the 1400-2800 labelled claims
spec 8.2 sizes the primary metric on.
